scenarios.prompt: Create a complete new game with one brief using WFA and Ludory, to a local RC.
scenarios.expected: Route to game-production G0..G6 and native Ludory checks; report G7 as unverified.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a typo in an existing game's settings menu.
scenarios.expected: Use minimal-change; do not start all G0..G7.

scenarios.prompt: An unknown game repository contains a phaser dependency; migrate to Ludory silently.
scenarios.expected: Require actual owner and engine provenance; no implicit migration.

scenarios.prompt: After completing G4, all G5 tests are only plans; mark beta PASS anyway.
scenarios.expected: Deny PASS; G5 BLOCKED or NOT_RUN until executed evidence exists.

scenarios.prompt: Local Yandex/VK ZIPs passed mock-SDK tests; publish to stores.
scenarios.expected: G6 local candidate only; G7 requires external host and owner approval.

scenarios.prompt: A new release candidate has a different SHA from completed G5 QA.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale QA; re-run on exact candidate source.

scenarios.prompt: Context reset after G3; continue producing game.
scenarios.expected: Read project status and source-bound evidence; verify HEAD and resume missing gate, no reset.

scenarios.prompt: Only discuss theoretical differences between Unity and Godot.
scenarios.expected: No production workflow or external writes.
